cases.name: an-assert-reads-a-field-two-pools-deep
cases.description: D.room.room_id is a field of the room the doctor's record points at; each= reads it like a formula does
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="r7" local="en"><pool name="Depts" count="3"><sequence name="dep_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Rooms" count="6"><sequence name="room_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="dept"><gen type="pool" value="Depts"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Docs" count="4"><sequence name="doc_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="room"><gen type="pool" value="Rooms"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="D"><gen type="pool" value="Docs"/></sequence><assert each="D.room.room_id >= 1" says="x"/></env><block><line><data>${{D.doc_id}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-assert-reads-a-field-three-pools-deep
cases.description: D.room.dept.dep_id, three links, was refused with a field list that named it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="r7" local="en"><pool name="Depts" count="3"><sequence name="dep_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Rooms" count="6"><sequence name="room_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="dept"><gen type="pool" value="Depts"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Docs" count="4"><sequence name="doc_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="room"><gen type="pool" value="Rooms"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="D"><gen type="pool" value="Docs"/></sequence><assert each="D.room.dept.dep_id >= 1" says="x"/></env><block><line><data>${{D.doc_id}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-if-reads-a-field-three-pools-deep
cases.description: the same path in a gen's if= condition
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="r7" local="en"><pool name="Depts" count="3"><sequence name="dep_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Rooms" count="6"><sequence name="room_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="dept"><gen type="pool" value="Depts"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Docs" count="4"><sequence name="doc_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="room"><gen type="pool" value="Rooms"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="D"><gen type="pool" value="Docs"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><gen type="text" value="a" if="D.room.dept.dep_id >= 1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{D.doc_id}}</data></line></block></tdc>
